description: Provenance for the vendored NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 catalog. NIST_SP-800-53_rev5_catalog.xml is a byte-for-byte copy of NIST's XML source at a pinned commit of the oscal-content main branch; NIST_SP-800-53_rev5_catalog.json is GENERATED from it by OscalCatalogXmlToJson (bin/rails catalog:build_rev5). NIST's own catalog metadata is left as NIST wrote it, so the record of where the file came from lives here (#1228).
pre_release_reason: NIST's fixes to SA-15(13), SA-24 and SI-02(07) are on oscal-content main (merged from develop and regenerated at OSCAL 1.2.3 on 2026-10-22) and in no NIST release yet. The catalog stays flagged until a release carries them; spec/lib/nist_catalog_source_spec.rb fails once the recorded release data shows one.
fixes: usnistgov/oscal-content#345 (fixes #343): SA-15(13) statement and Examine label
usnistgov/oscal-content#346 (fixes #301): SA-24 assessment-for links pointed into AC-2
known_upstream_findings: label-names-own-control: PL-08(01) assessment methods are labelled PL-08-Examine/-Interview/-Test
label-names-own-control: SC-32(01) assessment methods are labelled SC-32-Examine/-Interview/-Test
re_vendor: When a NIST release carries these fixes: replace the XML with the released file (or take NIST's released JSON), update this sidecar (commit, sha256, bytes, pre_release false), run bin/rails catalog:build_rev5 and bin/rails samples:odp_worksheets, and commit what they write.

previous_pins.note: Same control content; NIST's OSCAL 1.2.3 regeneration on main changed only metadata (oscal-version, a revision entry, a back-matter resource, the document uuid).

nist_published_json.verified: 2026-10-22: OscalCatalogXmlToJson's conversion of the vendored XML deep-equals NIST's own published JSON at this commit
